scope: Authored examples through the existing validator, bridge and planner. No new learner or model-service call.

checks.name: Useful evidence choice plus wrong command asks for production help only
Wrong evidence choice plus correct command asks for selection help only
Several criteria produce one capability observation with all evidence references
Partial command evidence does not become either a failure or a complete demonstration
An incidental criterion is retained without becoming a practice target
Known mathematical parts with wrong combination target integration only
Later parts alone cannot clear a previously observed integration error
One criterion reused by two capabilities retains the same evidence reference
A hint to a shared criterion qualifies both dependent capabilities only
A command-form hint leaves evidence choice and functional evidence independent
A reconstruction goal does not silently add fluent-recall observations or drills
Overlapping practice bundles schedule each pending target once
Semantic knowledge-group overlap changes no practice evidence or policy
Clarification maps a criterion to its capability and precedes corrective help
An unclear reply keeps mapped assessment unresolved without reviving help
A clear later response resolves mapped clarification and pending checks
A successful alternate path leaves bypassed targets unobserved without creating errors
Current correction ends immediate help while preserving a later check
Simple fact recall works without an integration or relationship requirement
An exact duplicate answer does not multiply evidence
A changed interpretation cannot silently replace the same answer ID
Saved assessments stay bound to their original criteria and coverage
A current contract version change rejects an old assessment
Contract wording drift is detected even without a version bump
Coverage of an unknown capability is rejected
Missing, repeated, or empty criterion mappings are rejected
Duplicate coverage cannot emit two observations for one capability
Help must identify affected rubric criteria in an explicit-coverage packet
An unmapped incidental criterion cannot become a remedial target
A new contract cannot reinterpret retained observations during intake
Direct planning detects a retained contract mismatch before choosing practice
A new version can start with new evidence without rewriting old history
Branch comparisons leave their initial evidence unchanged
Retained explicit evidence is a snapshot even when the caller later edits its packet
Version drift also blocks unresolved judgments that emitted no knowledge observation
Evidence references distinguish separate answers within the same attempt
Page handlers show focused command help then a combined later check
Mathematical walkthrough exposes integration while retaining separate evidence
Free play shows a partial answer without manufacturing a complete command observation
Version-drift walkthrough refuses reuse and reset restores an empty history
